_comment: Hand-curated historical series. Sources are named per row. Rows with traced=false keep cost_usd for audit, but it renders as n/a. Rows with 'logs' are checked against those run directories by tests/test_run_eval.py.

versions.label: One LangGraph ReAct agent (gpt-5.4) with an SPL verify gate, a sourcetype field manifest and a 15-step cap. The baseline.
Split into an SH orchestrator that plans and fresh gpt-5.4 senior workers that search, plus an extractor that submits a bare value. Same 20 correct: the split alone added no accuracy.
Plan-and-execute DAG: up to 6 seniors (GLM-5.2) chase competing hypotheses in parallel, and a junior tier takes single lookups. +6 correct, the biggest jump.
Crash-safe persistence, a grounding guard and structured findings. Same 26: most misses were the right evidence transcribed wrong, and 28 wrong answers were submitted with confidence.

Consensus voting removed (it never reached a majority); SH briefed with every sourcetype and the top 100 sources; seniors return a structured `submit_finding`. Found Q216's hidden Cisco feed, still 0/5.
Conversational loop: seniors keep their thread across rounds, and SH grades every report and routes the senior. With gpt-5.4-mini seniors: 0/5, but 3 honest refusals instead of guesses.
Same loop, with the senior swapped to the reasoning model GLM-5.3. 2/5: Q224 and Q328 solved for the first time in any version.
Only SH may answer: an exhausted budget becomes an explicit refusal instead of a senior's guess, and unverified premises are flagged and checked first. 2/5, 1 wrong, 2 refused.
Premise ledger (quotes must appear in real tool output), a blind validation agent (v0.4.2 to v0.4.3) and soundness checks. 2/5; Q216 moved from a stable 112 to within 1 of the answer.
SH memory across questions and per-turn resume. 24/50 correct with only 4 wrong answers submitted; the other 22 were refusals.
